alex: Quick check — planning to bump route-routing.feature_flags.batch_size from 8 -> 50 for /generate in prod to reduce p99 tails. Any objections?

marta: Hmm that's a big jump. What's the traffic distribution? :thinking:

alex: 80% of traffic is short seq (<64). We expect batching to help. But risk is Q delay for tail reqs.

jamal: Can we do a staged change? e.g., cohort-based = 10% -> 30% -> 100% with 15m windows. Also need telemetry: runtime.batch.latency_p99 and queue_depth.

alex: agreed. Proposed rollout snippet in console API:
```
PATCH /api/v1/configs/route/generate
{"batch_size":50, "cohort_rules": [{"percent":10, "duration":"15m"}, {"percent":30, "duration":"30m"}]}
```

any missing signals?

marta: add a synthetic probe that sends 1k requests at ~burst rates + perf-dashboard tile for tail CPU and observed throughput. Also add fallback policy: if p99 increases >20% revert.

jamal: I'll add the dashboard panels and preflight job in CI. CI note: `scripts/rollout_preflight.sh --route generate` will simulate. I can run now.

ci-bot: preflight job queued #4721

alex: thanks — if preflight passes, I'll schedule 10% cohort at 2026-03-21T16:00Z. cc @oncall

oncall: noted, will monitor. set alert: runtime.batch.p99 > baseline*1.2 for 5m -> pager.

alex: sweet. keeping short, will post results here. :thumbsup:
